description: This file defines the StepAdapter class, a custom PagerAdapter for managing and displaying steps in a showcase/tutorial within an Android application. It handles view creation, button callbacks, and step data management.

classes.name: StepAdapter
classes.description: A PagerAdapter subclass that manages a list of steps for a showcase fragment, creating views for each step and handling button callbacks.

methods.name: StepAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with context and list of steps.

methods.name: setButtonCallbacks
methods.description: Sets callback functions for finish, cancel, and next buttons.

methods.name: instantiateItem
methods.description: Creates and initializes the view for a specific step at the given position.

methods.name: destroyItem
methods.description: Removes the view for a specific step.

methods.name: getStep
methods.description: Returns the step object at the specified index.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of steps.

methods.name: isViewFromObject
methods.description: Checks if a view corresponds to a specific object.
